## Author checklist

- [ ] The archive was built from the linked source and contains no secrets.
- [ ] The manifest ID and version match the registry paths and metadata.
- [ ] Requested permissions are necessary and documented.
- [ ] The plugin and included media use licenses that permit distribution.
- [ ] This ID/version has not been published before.
- [ ] I tested the packaged archive in a current Grainery release.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Automated validation passes.
- [ ] Source, publisher, permissions, network access, and licensing were reviewed.
- [ ] Screenshots and catalog text accurately represent the plugin.
- [ ] The archive is approved for signing and publication.
